title: Recursive_self-improvement
summary: The technological singularity – also, simply, the singularity – is a hypothetical future point in time at which technological growth becomes uncontrollable and irreversible, resulting in unforeseeable changes to human civilization. I. J. Good's "intelligence explosion" model predicts that a future superintelligence will trigger a singularity. Four polls, conducted in 2012 and 2013, suggested that the median estimate was a 50% chance that artificial general intelligence (AGI) would be developed by 2040–2050.
